analyst.text: Cleveland bought some breathing room by winning at Madison Square Garden behind James Harden's season-high 32. That came days after Marc Stein said Kenny Atkinson's job needed "a very close eye". Miami open a five-game homestand after a 3-2 West trip. Giannis Antetokounmpo is playing through a sprained wrist and is still answering Doc Rivers' public jab at his basketball IQ. The Heat's homecoming and Giannis's edge lean slightly toward Miami, but Cleveland's urgency keeps it close.
